name: Bladesinging
description: A wizard subclass that adds the Bladesinging tradition from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.

grants.name: Bladesinger Styles
grants.description: Choose the visual style and tradition of your Bladesong; this choice has no mechanical effect.

grants.name: Bladesong
grants.description: As a Bonus Action for 1 minute while not using Medium or Heavy Armor or a Shield, add Intelligence to AC and Concentration saves, gain 10 feet of Speed, and gain Advantage on Acrobatics. Uses equal your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

grants.name: Training in War and Song (Bladesinging)
grants.description: Gain Light Armor proficiency, proficiency with one one-handed melee weapon, and proficiency in Performance.

grants.name: Extra Attack
grants.description: Attack twice when you take the Attack action, and you can replace one attack with a cantrip.

grants.name: Song of Defense
grants.description: While Bladesong is active, use your Reaction and expend a spell slot to reduce incoming damage by five times the slot's level.

grants.name: Song of Victory
grants.description: While Bladesong is active, add your Intelligence modifier to melee weapon damage rolls.
